name: idea-to-issue
summary: Research an idea, check its draft, post a private-text-checked issue and choose what happens next. The first option at every point is the default.

options.label: A review turn corrects the draft
options.summary: Compare the research with the code and correct the draft file.
options.change: Keep reviewByTurn as checkDraft in idea-to-issue.ts.

options.label: I read the draft
options.summary: Capture the draft through a protected effect and show its text to reviewByPerson. Post only if the captured digest still matches.
options.change: Import reviewDraftByPerson as checkDraft from idea-to-issue/review.ts in idea-to-issue.ts. Add capture-draft to methods.github. Set selection.review to person in idea-to-issue/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Post after the privacy check
options.summary: Post after the existing privacy check; retain any digest from a person review.
options.change: Keep postAfterPrivacy as postDraft in idea-to-issue.ts. Configure privateTexts with at least one nonblank item.

options.label: I approve the post
options.summary: Capture and show the draft in an approval gate before the checked post. Preserve both reviewed digests when both gates are selected.
options.change: Import postByPerson as postDraft from idea-to-issue/post-person.ts in idea-to-issue.ts. Add capture-draft to methods.github. Set selection.post to person in idea-to-issue/scenarios.ts. Configure privateTexts with at least one nonblank item.

points.question: What happens to the posted issue?

options.label: Hand the issue to develop
options.summary: Start the repository-declared develop workflow. If starting it fails, put the issue in the queue.
options.change: Keep handoffIssue as nextIssue in idea-to-issue.ts. Set targetWorkflow in idea-to-issue/next.ts and workflow.handoffs in idea-to-issue.declaration.json to the same repository-declared workflow ID. The default is develop.

options.label: Put the issue in the queue
options.summary: Add cloving: ready without starting a develop workflow.
options.change: Import queueIssue as nextIssue from idea-to-issue/queue.ts in idea-to-issue.ts. Set workflow.handoffs to [] and selection.next to queue in idea-to-issue/scenarios.ts. No develop workflow is required.

options.label: Do nothing
options.summary: Leave the posted issue for a person.
options.change: Import leaveIssue as nextIssue from idea-to-issue/leave.ts in idea-to-issue.ts. Set workflow.handoffs to [], remove label from methods.github and set selection.next to nothing in idea-to-issue/scenarios.ts. No develop workflow is required.
